reason: Live check of a dashboard change copied two edited files into the shared main checkout, and cleanup failed to restore them for about two minutes. No skill covers live verification of a worktree change against seeded local fixtures, so the rule and the seeding recipe belong in one place.

The user-lens verification of the sign-in loop hit three traps not in the skill: the default preview config bypasses auth, a cold compile looked like a blank page, and a stale cookie kept the loop running. Each cost a re-run, so the recipe belongs with the existing live-verify steps.

Verifying a server-rendered, zone-dependent value (the dashboard "today" tile and header zone label) was faster and deterministic with curl and a Cookie header on the worktree server, with the server pinned to TZ=UTC to mirror Vercel. The browser pane also came back empty while hidden, and the cookie jar was shared with the main session and browser subagents.

This episode could not get :3100 or :3200 (peer sessions held them) and had to ship as not live-verified. The skill should say what to do in that case, so the next session does not verify on the production-pointed port.

This session re-learned four live-check facts: fixtures go stale at local midnight, the in-app browser is pinned to HKT so other organiser zones need a Playwright context, the TZ=UTC launch config must be reverted, and before/after proof works best as one grid.
